chapters.screen: Linear SVM. A support vector machine wants more than the right side of the boundary: it wants every passenger at least a margin away from it. Watch the boundary and its dashed margin lines move as training repeats over the passengers.
chapters.spoken: Linear S-V-M. A support vector machine wants more than the right side of the boundary: it wants every passenger at least a margin away from it. Watch the boundary and its dashed margin lines move as training repeats over the passengers.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: After one pass: the solid line is score 0, the dashed lines are scores −1 and +1. The shading is a score, not a probability.
chapters.spoken: After one pass: the solid line is score 0, the dashed lines are scores minus 1 and plus 1. The shading is a score, not a probability.

chapters.screen: Each frame is one real epoch of SGD on hinge loss + 0.0003 × ½|weights|². Passengers inside the margin, or on the wrong side, are the ones that move the boundary.
chapters.spoken: Each frame is one real epoch of S-G-D on hinge loss plus 0.0003 times half the squared weights. Passengers inside the margin, or on the wrong side, are the ones that move the boundary.

chapters.screen: After 30 epochs: train accuracy 74%, validation 72%. A stronger penalty (α = 0.01) ignores age and fare, splits on sex alone, and scores 78%.
chapters.spoken: After 30 epochs: train accuracy 74%, validation 72%. A stronger penalty (alpha equals 0.01) ignores age and fare, splits on sex alone, and scores 78%.

chapters.screen: An unseen passenger: the score is bias + weight × input; its sign is the prediction. |score| < 1 means it falls inside the margin.
chapters.spoken: An unseen passenger: the score is bias plus weight times input; its sign is the prediction. a score between minus 1 and plus 1 means it falls inside the margin.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: The linear SVM's score is a flat, tilted plane for each sex: two parallel planes, offset by the effect of sex. Height is the model's score, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: The linear S-V-M's score is a flat, tilted plane for each sex: two parallel planes, offset by the effect of sex. Height is the model's score, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 72% with every input against 76% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 72% with every input against 76% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: A linear SVM looks for the widest margin it can afford; the penalty decides how much detail it keeps. Limitation: it gives a score, not a probability, and a straight boundary cannot capture patterns such as 'young boys survived'.
chapters.spoken: A linear S-V-M looks for the widest margin it can afford; the penalty decides how much detail it keeps. Limitation: it gives a score, not a probability, and a straight boundary cannot capture patterns such as 'young boys survived'.
